
set(NLOHMANN_JSON_BUILD_MODULES             ON CACHE BOOL   "Build C++ modules support" FORCE)
set(JSON_BuildTests                         OFF CACHE BOOL  "Build the unit tests when BUILD_TESTING is enabled." FORCE)
set(JSON_CI                                 OFF CACHE BOOL  "Enable CI build targets." FORCE)
set(JSON_Diagnostics                        OFF CACHE BOOL  "Use extended diagnostic messages." FORCE)
set(JSON_Diagnostic_Positions               OFF CACHE BOOL  "Enable diagnostic positions." FORCE)
set(JSON_GlobalUDLs                         OFF CACHE BOOL  "Place user-defined string literals in the global namespace." FORCE)
set(JSON_ImplicitConversions                OFF CACHE BOOL  "Enable implicit conversions." FORCE)
set(JSON_DisableEnumSerialization           OFF CACHE BOOL  "Disable default integer enum serialization." FORCE)
set(JSON_DisableTupleReferenceConversion    OFF CACHE BOOL  "Disable conversion from a one-element tuple of a JSON reference." FORCE)
set(JSON_LegacyDiscardedValueComparison     OFF CACHE BOOL  "Enable legacy discarded value comparison." FORCE)
set(JSON_Install                            OFF CACHE BOOL  "Install CMake targets during install step." FORCE)
set(JSON_MultipleHeaders                    ON CACHE BOOL   "Use non-amalgamated version of the library." FORCE)
set(JSON_SystemInclude                      OFF CACHE BOOL  "Include as system headers (skip for clang-tidy)." FORCE)
set(JSON_StrictNulHandling                  ON CACHE BOOL   "Build with strict NUL-byte handling enabled." FORCE)
set(JSON_StrictBinaryUTF8                   ON CACHE BOOL   "Build with UTF-8 checks in the CBOR, UBJSON, BJData, and BSON writers enabled." FORCE)
set(JSON_DeleteDeprecatedFunctions          ON CACHE BOOL   "Delete the deprecated functions instead of only deprecating them." FORCE)

add_subdirectory(upstream EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
add_third_party_module("JSON for Modern C++" https://github.com/nlohmann/json ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream/LICENSE.MIT)
